name: Matsukawa Iori
source:
Hobby: Art Appreciation, Driving

A 3rd year at Shoukei Academy.
His family is famous for doing Kabuki and he used to play women's roles.
But a certain incident happened and he took a chance and dropped everything to go to America.
He recently came back to Japan and is freeloading at [url=/c46075]Kazuya's[/url] house.
He has a showy charm and is really popular among the female students.
